title: Diffusion models design and optimise antibodies, with improved flavivirus binding
summary: Two diffusion models, AbDesign for antibody sequences and structures and AbDock for paratope-epitope docking, form an optimisation pipeline. On independent test sets AbDesign reached a 2.56 A RMSD and 36.47% amino acid recovery, and AbDock a DockQ of 0.44. Optimising the flavivirus antibody 1G5.3 gave a broad-spectrum variant with improved binding to 6 of the 9 flaviviruses tested. Preprint; one antibody and binding only, not neutralisation.
ai_technology: Diffusion models AbDesign and AbDock for CDR design and docking-based screening

evidence.tested: Experimental binding of the optimised 1G5.3 antibody to nine flaviviruses.
evidence.unknown: Neutralisation, generality to other antibodies and number of variants tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Diffusion models proposed CDR designs and screened them by docking.
